anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: The Edge Mountain Retreat: Mystical Hogsback Escape with Panoramic Views & Fireside Charm
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Nestled in the heart of Hogsback's Amathole Mountains, The Edge Mountain Retreat offers a truly mystical escape. Experience breathtaking panoramic views, cozy self-catering accommodation, and a tranquil atmosphere perfect for nature lovers and creative souls. Our renowned restaurant and bar serve delicious fare, while the surrounding forests invite hiking, bird watching, and exploration of local artistry. Unwind by the fireplace, connect with genuine local hospitality, and discover the magic that inspired legends in this unique Eastern Cape gem. A true sanctuary where mountains, music, and local magic converge.
